description: This Java source file defines a test class CobPartitioningTest that conducts integration testing of the COB (Close of Business) partitioning logic for loans within the Fineract platform. It sets up loan data, manages business dates, and verifies the proper partitioning of loans into COB segments via REST API calls, utilizing concurrent execution to stress test the partitioning mechanism.

classes.description: A JUnit test suite for integration testing COB partitioning logic in loan workflows of the Fineract platform, utilizing REST API calls, multi-threaded execution, and business date manipulations to verify correct segmentation of loans into COB partitions.
